title: Measurement and Fairness
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is the application of measurement modeling to the concept of fairness in computational systems. It explicitly treats fairness as an "essentially contested construct" with multiple, conflicting theoretical and ethical underpinnings. The paper argues that debates over fairness definitions are not merely technical but are fundamentally debates about values. This deep engagement with the nature of fairness as an ethical concept is a core component of the paper, not a peripheral discussion.
